hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the enemy.
If not the register's 'hasFirstReviveDesclaw' and the HP fraction of part 1 of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_appearance_of_deathclaw" in aiArg, then run helper and stop.
Otherwise, if the register's 'hasFirstReviveDesclaw' and (part 2 of the enemy is dead or part 2 of the enemy is judged dead) and (count up "turnForReviveDesclaw", then the count "turnForReviveDesclaw" is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_to_resurrection_of_deathclaw" in aiArg), then run helper and stop.
Otherwise, return nothing.

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
(part 2 of the enemy) → reset-all-param-constraint-attributes.
Let v be a revive sequence {deformTag: "deformation_01", nos: [2], shouldReset: true}.
If not the register's 'hasFirstReviveDesclaw', then
  Append [{messageSuffixNo: "02"}] to v.
  Set the register's 'hasFirstReviveDesclaw' to true.
Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: v} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
Reset the count "turnForReviveDesclaw".

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v be call helper2.
If v, then v → unset-status-ailments with (the TARGET_BUDDY status).
If the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 1, then
  For each part in the living parts of the acting enemy, finish off part.
Return true.
